title: Programiz: Check Leap Year
description: Given a year `year`, return `True` if it is a leap year, and `False` otherwise.
solution:
def is_leap_year(year: int) -> bool:
    return (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0)
explanation: Leap year rules: divisible by 4 and not 100, or divisible by 400.
